rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion applying Humphrey’s Executor as controlling and rejecting an as-applied “modern FTC” carveout as an unadministrable, de facto overruling, while emphasizing that the President did not invoke statutory cause. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (especially Thomas) pressing an Article II originalist correction, and from one or more majority justices (notably Barrett or Sotomayor/Kagan) to underscore stare decisis/administrability and flag that any reconsideration of Humphrey’s must be forthright.
